feet: bottom row of the frame, centred at x=127; the figure faces right

magic.rule: each pixel of the magic slot is one of these greys; replace by the cast spell's ramp (near-white, light, mid, deep); pure white stays white. See godot/magic_ramp.gdshader.

file_pattern: <slot>/<variant>.png where <variant> joins the slot's depends_on option values with '-' unless the slot's `alias` table sends that choice to another file (choices that draw the same picture share one). A missing file means that slot is empty for that choice.
draw_order: slots are listed back to front
